newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Norish says overall outlook positive.
newsitem.headline: Norish says overall outlook positive.

text.p: Irish cold storage firm Norish Plc said on Wednesday that the outlook for the group was positive as a result of improved trading conditions in the industry in the UK.
Norish said in a statement that its disposal of Eirfreeze Dublin and its controlling stake in Norish Kilkenny during the results period contributed to improved profits.

The firm said it sold the remaining Irish-based County Monaghan facility and entered into a joint purchase agreement with the purchasers regarding the future operation of the plant which includes a rationalisation programme.
The company said it now had four UK-based commercial cold storage facilities and all four operated profitably in the first half of 1996.
"These business units have been extending their services to food manufacturers and retailers by offering tailor-made collection, storage and delivery services," Norish said.
Earlier, the company announced a pre-tax profit of 0.69 million Irish pounds for the six months to June 30 compared with a loss of 0.57 million in the same period of 1995.
Norish said the results represented a welcome return to profitability after a period of heavy rationalisation and disposal.
